answer: The haven register is checked at draw time, shale lists the eligible set, and fable seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 41 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone forfeits for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 41 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. A 218 account operation therefore ties up 7 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
